SAR.note: Sign of the Saudi riyal approved by King Salman on 20 February 2025 (21/08/1446 AH) and published by the Saudi Central Bank; encoded in Unicode 17.0. CLDR 49 offers it only as the alt="variant" symbol, so formatters keep the letter abbreviation by default.

sources.name: Saudi Central Bank (SAMA): Saudi riyal symbol

AED.note: Sign of the UAE dirham unveiled by the Central Bank of the UAE on 27 March 2025 (a Latin D with two horizontal bars; the Digital Dirham mark encloses it in a circle and is not this character); encoded in Unicode 18.0. CLDR 49 offers it only as the alt="variant" symbol. Fonts and systems that predate Unicode 18.0 will not render it.

sources.name: Central Bank of the UAE: press release, new Dirham symbol

OMR.note: Sign of the Omani rial launched by the Central Bank of Oman, reported on 19 November 2025; encoded in Unicode 18.0. CLDR 49 offers it only as the alt="variant" symbol. The central bank's own page could not be retrieved (HTTP 503), so the date rests on press coverage.

sources.name: Oman Observer: Symbol for Omani Rial launched
